events.title: Transformer lead-time pressure could accelerate modular replacement strategies
events.summary: Signals point to transformer supply strain driven by concurrent data-center and electrification demand. Operators may increasingly use modular or temporary assets to manage near-term gaps.

events.title: Local congestion signals may shift storage deployment toward edge sites
events.summary: Signals point to increased interest in edge battery deployments to manage local renewable curtailment and defer network upgrades.

events.title: Signals of localized processing investments could shift export dynamics for battery materials
events.summary: Signals of increased local processing could alter export mixes and create new demand for energy and equipment in mining regions.

events.title: Onsite generation signals rise as data-center operators seek resilience against grid constraints
events.summary: Signs point to greater adoption of onsite generation and hybrid microgrids by data centers in constrained markets to improve resilience.

events.title: Transition signals toward hybrid HVDC corridors and modular GIS upgrades
events.summary: Scenario signals favor hybrid HVDC corridors combined with modular GIS upgrades in constrained sites, increasing demand for converters and alternative insulating technologies.

events.title: Local supplier development signals to shorten project lead times
events.summary: Procurement signals favor local supplier development to shorten delivery windows for grid projects, with implications for capacity building and QA needs.

events.title: Capacity mechanism signals could surface as renewables displace dispatchable capacity
events.summary: Signals suggest capacity-market or incentive discussions may accelerate to manage reliability as renewable penetration increases.

events.title: AI-enabled load forecasting adoption may improve flexibility while exposing new cyber risk vectors
events.summary: AI forecasting could yield efficiency gains but introduces dependency on data integrity and model governance, creating new cybersecurity considerations.

events.title: Bushfire risk signals accelerate substation hardening and remote monitoring pilots
events.summary: Signals favor accelerated substation hardening and remote monitoring pilots in fire-exposed regions to reduce outage and asset-damage risk.

events.title: Second-life batteries for grid services signal pilot scaling but standards gaps remain
events.summary: Pilot scaling of second-life batteries offers service potential but faces standards and regulatory uncertainty that could slow large-scale deployment.
